svg.title: Waves
svg.desc: Two waves plotted across the same distance at equal propagation speed. The lower-frequency wave has two cycles and a longer wavelength; the higher-frequency wave has four cycles and half that wavelength.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Two snapshots over the same distance; both waves travel at the same speed.

path.style: stroke: rgb(0%,49%,51%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 3; fill: none; fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: rgb(32%,41%,47%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 3, 3;
stroke: rgb(32%,41%,47%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 3, 3;

polygon.style: stroke: rgb(0%,49%,51%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(0%,49%,51%); fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: rgb(0%,49%,51%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(0%,49%,51%); fill-rule: evenodd;

path.style: stroke: rgb(0%,49%,51%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 3; fill: none; fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: rgb(32%,41%,47%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 3, 3;
stroke: rgb(32%,41%,47%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 3, 3;

polygon.style: stroke: rgb(0%,49%,51%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(0%,49%,51%); fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: rgb(0%,49%,51%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(0%,49%,51%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Crest-to-crest on a distance axis measures wavelength.
These are schematic field patterns, not the path followed by a particle.
